description: At Spartan Racing, we’re more than just a student team—we’re a group of passionate individuals working together to design, build, and race a formula-style car from the ground up. Based at San José State University, we create a space where students from all backgrounds can learn by doing, challenge themselves, and grow both technically and professionally. Our mission is to build a competitive car, support each other as a team, and represent SJSU with pride at Formula SAE competitions. Along the way, we gain real experience, form lasting connections, and have a lot of fun doing what we love.

Our first workshop, a smartphone and scam-safety session for 30 seniors at ONEgeneration in June 2026, was taught from real scam messages, and that is how we approach everything: practical, patient, and built around the people we serve.

We aim to be the most credible organization on campus for companies to confidently hire top-tier, rigorously trained sales talent.

description: Our mission is to be a clear and confident pro-Israel voice on college campuses and to support students in grassroots pro-Israel advocacy. We are committed to promoting a better understanding of Israel worldwide a as a member of the family of nations, with a fundamental right to exist as a Jewish, democratic state, within secure borders. name: Table Tennis
description: Our mission is to build a welcoming and inclusive community for students at SJSU through the sport of table tennis. We aim to create opportunities for growth both on and off the table by promoting teamwork, healthy competition, and lifelong skills such as leadership, discipline, and sportsmanship.

name: Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) at San Jose State University
description: We are a cultural club that will help students from Taiwan adapt to SJSU, as well as introduce Taiwanese culture to other students. TSA will be helping students with schedule changes, advising, and other aspects that students may need help with. Our goal is to help you, so please don't hesitate to ask!

name: Tapman at SJSU
description: To bring together students to watch, appreciate, and learn the art of tap dancing.

name: Tau Beta Pi
description: Tau Beta Pi at San José State University (California Eta Chapter) upholds the national mission of recognizing engineering students who demonstrate distinguished scholarship and exemplary character. Founded on the values of integrity, breadth of interest, adaptability, and unselfish service, the chapter promotes leadership, academic excellence, and ethical responsibility. It seeks to honor individuals who contribute meaningfully to their university and community while fostering a spirit of liberal culture within the engineering profession.

name: The Line Dancing Club
description: Our mission is to cultivate a welcoming community while also fostering an environment that encourages confidence on and off the dance floor!

name: The Shrunkenheadman Club
description: The Shrunkenheadman Club (SHM) exists to help Animation/Illustration students with their field of study.

name: The Society of Quantum Engineers
description: The Society of Quantum Engineers connects SJSU students, alumni, and faculty in a community dedicated to advancing quantum engineering education, mentorship, and collaboration with industry and research partners.

name: The Spartones
description: To allow students to compete and perform A Capella arrangements, furthering their personal interests.

description: Raising money for the Spring 2027 Nursing Pinning Ceremony

name: The Valley Foundation School of Nursing Fall 2028
description: Our mission is to start fundraisers to make the pinning ceremony possible for our cohort.

name: The Valley Foundation School of Nursing, Class of Fall 2026
description: The purpose of this organization is to raise the funds needed to plan the pinning ceremony for The Valley Foundation School of Nursing, Class of Fall of 2026.

name: Theta Chi Fraternity
description: Our mission is to build resolute men on our campus. We do this by promoting truth, temperance, and tolerance. We strive for our members to be the best versions of themselves they can be. Our sacred purpose is to provide health and safety information to our brothers and the broader campus community.

name: Theta Tau
description: The purpose of Theta Tau is to develop and maintain a high standard of professional interest among its members, and to unite them in a strong bond of fraternal fellowship.

name: Trans Talk
description: Support the well-being of trans, nonbinary, and gender questioning SJSU students and create an SJSU community where trans people can thrive and live authentically

name: TRANSITion SJSU
description: Our mission is to facilitate dialogue regarding local planning, public transit, and innovative approaches to both, while advocating for a diversity in ideas, organization, politics, and grassroots efforts.

name: Turning Point USA
description: Our mission is to educate students about the importance of freedom, free markets, and limited government. We also empower young activists to get involved in the fight for free markets and limited government. Through building strong campus networks, organizing conferences, and equipping activists with the knowledge and strategies needed to combat the left, TPUSA empowers young people to make a difference within their community. This club also helps students register to vote. TPUSA has helped thousands of college students apply for voter registration and access absentee ballots.

name: UHS Residence Hall Association
description: RHA (Residence Hall Association) will act as the voice of all SJSU residential students in important affairs and will seek to improve the residential experience through advocacy, provision of opportunities, in relation to leadership development and personal growth, and by building a community in which all residents can feel at home.

name: Undergraduate Public Health Online Association
description: The mission of UPHOA is to empower SJSU undergraduate public health students through virtual collaboration, fostering a supportive online community that promotes health equity, advocacy, research, and leadership development.

name: Undergraduate Social Work Association (USWA)
description: The purpose of the Undergraduate Social Work Association is to increase communications between students and faculty, raise funds for graduation of students from the School of Social Work and create a network between all social work students.

name: UNICEF Club at SJSU
description: To advocate for and promote children's education, survivability/health, safety, and development. Additionally, the organization spreads awareness to students, builds a safe community and environment, and holds fundraisers to support children's health and safety. UNICEF also provides volunteer opportunities to promote children's education.

name: United Sorority and Fraternity Council (USFC)
description: The United Sorority & Fraternity Council (USFC) at San José State University serves as the coordinating body for our council's culturally diverse fraternities and sororities. USFC exists to assist member organizations in the achievement of their founding purposes, to provide a forum for the governance and regulation of chapter affairs, and to serve as a liaison between our chapters and the university administration. name: Urban Planning Coalition
description: The purpose of this organization is to create a safe environment for planners to share ideas, to create a sense of community for students in the Master’s in Urban Planning Program, and to establish life-long connections between fellow planners.

name: Valley Foundation School of Nursing Fall 2027 Cohort at San José State University
description: To foster a supportive and collaborative environment to raise the funds, with the assistance of San José State University and its resources, necessary to organize a successful Pinning Ceremony in December 2027 that marks the completion of nursing school for the Fall 2027 cohort.

name: Valley Foundation School of Nursing, Class of Spring 2028
description: The purpose of this organization is to raise the funds needed to plan the pinning ceremony for The Valley Foundation School of Nursing Class of Spring of 2028.

name: Valorant Club
description: To create a welcoming esports community around the video game Valorant and to develop junior esports teams in order to compete.

name: Veterans Student Organization
description: We are a service and support group at San Jose State University which is located in the Silicon Valley. Our mission is to bring past, present, and future members of the Armed Forces together to promote, unify and support the military veteran voice on and off campus. Our aims are to educate the campus and local community about how the military has affected our lives and to support one another through the transition process of reintegration. name: Vietnamese Student Association
description: The purpose of the Vietnamese Student Association at SJSU is to serve the Vietnamese community by preserving and sharing Vietnamese culture and traditions. We aim to keep our culture alive for those born or raised outside of Vietnam and welcome people of all backgrounds who want to learn. We work together to create a supportive environment that encourages education, leadership, and teamwork.

name: Women and Gender Minorities in Physics
description: Our mission is to create a welcoming and supportive community for women and gender minorities in physics, where members can connect, collaborate, and build a sense of belonging. We foster these connections through social activities, which creates opportunities to engage with faculty who share similar identities and experiences. We strive to reduce isolation and create a space where members feel comfortable sharing their experiences and support one another. We keep members informed about events and initiatives within the department and across campus to encourage broader engagement.

name: Women in Animation Student Chapter at San Jose State University
description: Women In Animation is dedicated to advancing underrepresented genders in the field of animation. As an organization, we envision a world where underrepresented genders share equally in the creation, production and rewards of animation in all industries including visual effects, feature length animation, TV programming, Gaming, VR and AR, and we provide resources and connections to make it happen. name: Women in Aviation SJSU
description: The Purpose of Women in Aviation is to promote relationships with the aviation industry, mentor students seeking aviation-related careers, promote women in the aviation industry, and outreach to younger generations. Women in Aviation at San Jose State University is affiliated with the San Francisco Bay Area Women in Aviation Chapter’s outreach program. This affiliation gives students a direct contact to aviation-industry members who can provide mentorship and guidance.

name: Women in Business
description: Women in Business (WIB) is dedicated to empowering, educating, and enabling women to excel in the business world. Through professional development, industry exposure, mentorship, and community-building initiatives, we provide members with the skills, experiences, and connections needed to thrive in their careers.

name: Women in Construction
description: The mission of Women in Construction (WIC) at San José State University is to empower and support students pursuing careers in construction and the built environment by fostering professional development, leadership, mentorship, networking, and community. WIC strives to promote diversity and inclusion within the construction industry while connecting members with industry professionals, educational opportunities, and hands-on experiences that prepare them for successful careers.

name: Women in Cybersecurity, San Jose State University Student Chapter
description: The mission of WiCyS SJSU is to empower and support women and underrepresented groups in cybersecurity through professional development, technical learning, mentorship, networking, and community building.

name: Women in Data Science
description: To cultivate the next generation of Data Science and AI leaders by providing resources for upskilling, networking, mentorship, and growth opportunities, from students to professionals.

name: Women’s Club Basketball
description: Our mission is to create a competitive and supportive environment where women can grow as athletes, teammates, and leaders. We strive to build a strong community through our shared passion for basketball while promoting teamwork, sportsmanship, and personal growth both on and off the court.

name: Women's Club Soccer
description: To promote a collaborative and competitive community filled with like-minded members who want to continue playing at a higher level.

name: Women's Club Volleyball
description: To create a volleyball team with a great group of women that can build friendships and compete at a high level during the season.

name: Women's Club Water Polo
description: Our club water polo team is committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and inclusive environment where students of all backgrounds and skill levels can participate in competitive athletics, develop their water polo abilities, build meaningful friendships, and grow as teammates and individuals. We strive to foster sportsmanship, respect, teamwork, and a sense of community both in and out of the pool.

name: Women's Lacrosse
description: The San José State University Women’s Club Lacrosse Team is a competitive D2 program open to players of all experience levels. Our mission is to grow the sport of lacrosse, build a strong community, compete with heart, and have fun doing it. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where athletes can develop their skills, form lasting friendships, and strive for success on and off the field.

name: Women's Rugby Club
description: We are an ambitious group of athletes who share the common goal of playing rugby and creating lifelong memories and relationships on the way.

name: Young Democratic Socialists of America
description: To promote democratic socialist practices at SJSU
